case.title: Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2025–2030
case.author: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services; U.S. Department of Agriculture
case.provenance: Owner-supplied PDF. The title/footer identify realfood.gov; a fresh download from its official CDN matches the supplied byte count and SHA-256. Current publisher resources can point to a separate accessibility revision, which is not substituted for this fixture.
case.rightsBasis: U.S. Government HHS/USDA publication; development corpus only, not relicensed under MIT.

rightsClearance.scope: Commercial use and redistribution of the development corpus; retain source attribution.

coverage: reading order across repeated horizontal sections
case.reviewStatus: Shading support permits reflowed text on nine pages; EPUBCheck and 192 MiB Mac gate pass. Ten pages prepared for comparison. Native word/label, protein-column order and placeholder-heading defects remain; not fidelity-qualified.

knownFidelityIssues.issue: Title words join, native words split, and food-pyramid labels lose grouping.
Protein bullet columns interleave; object placeholders become headings. Large connected graphics retain a full-page reference image.

memoryBudget.scope: macOS 27 arm64 isolated release CLI, defaults; initial regression ceiling, not an iOS device budget

measurementScope: One process run; RSS excludes separate Apple services. Timing excludes validation. Not a latency distribution or physical mobile-device measurement.

progressCheck.scope: CLI work fraction, page bounds and completion; not elapsed-time prediction
